description.value: Mangez Mangez is a French-Mediterranean café established in 1999 by a French entrepreneur in the Coal Harbour district of downtown Vancouver, serving fresh soups, sandwiches, pastries, and specialty coffee prepared daily in an open kitchen. Now in its third decade, it is a neighbourhood lunch staple that also offers online ordering for pickup and delivery, as well as corporate catering. Cyclists cutting through downtown Vancouver will find a quick, wholesome meal stop a short ride from the waterfront seawall.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 32m; stands (5 spaces) at 52m; stands (8 spaces) at 56m; stands (5 spaces) at 81m; stands (5 spaces) at 89m; stands (5 spaces) at 98m. Total: 32 spaces.

OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes (checked 2025-05-27) is not confirmed by the website text, so left null. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists only Mo-Fr 07:00-16:00, but the website also shows Sat-Sun hours (7:00 AM – 2:00 PM) — the OSM record is incomplete on hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café in downtown Vancouver with a live website, confirmed address, and a long operating history since 1999.
